author: Hendrik Vrey
name: Hail plugin
description: A plugin for Hail, the keyboard launcher: one provider, its plugin.json, and a build that can copy it into Hail's plugins folder.

pluginId.description: The plugin's id: lower-case words joined by dots, such as yourname.myplugin. Its folder under Hail's plugins folder is named after it.

publisher.description: Who you are, as Hail shows it when it asks whether to enable the plugin.

keyword.description: The word that, typed first in Hail's box, sends a search to this plugin alone.

sdkVersion.description: The Hail.Sdk package version to build against.
